title: Create capacitor crafting fix
description: Fix the capacitor crafting using the zinc sheet from Create Deco mod instead of the Craft and Additions one.
body:
This datapack fix the Create Crafts & Additions mod capacitor crafting using the zinc sheet from Create Deco mod instead the Create Crafts & Additions one.


P.S. Thanks to the reddit user exocyt0sis for creating the code
